scope: Authoritative design-to-contract mapping, not a provider registry, auth result, runtime reader, or claim that Host has composed a source.
rules: Each module owns and declares its contribution. Host only composes supplied ports; do not enumerate these rows to invent module readers or pending providers.

Root ids with multiple projections are presentation groups; consume their explicitly listed child ids. Do not emit a fabricated root value. Patterns <taskId>/<channelId>/<generationId>/<recordId>/<providerCategoryId>/<providerSourceId>/<providerScopeId> are stable ids declared by the owning provider, never names or categories guessed by Host.

defaultAvailability is a no-data baseline, never a live reading. published means a public port is known, not that it is configured, authorized, fresh or adopted. Unknown/unimplemented source ports stay null in this mapping and pending in the presentation; do not invent a source reader.

Amounts/people unions/category totals are owned by providers. A missing aggregate stays pending even if a detail page exists. No implicit FX, channel/DAU sums, wallet-to-person inference or current-page-to-global counts.

Health design cards may explicitly consume parameters/people child values as listed; section is the wire section, designSection is the design screen. Do not move values into failures or text to bypass a type.
